title: BLASTS CRACK CLOSE AND RUMBLE FAR
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sound and give actions a distinct noise. Every explosive, a Frag Charge, a tripwire mine, a Howler shell, a cook-off, played the same short soft burst, the same near and far, only quieter, and on laptop speakers it barely landed. Now a blast close to you hits with a bright crack that falls into a heavy body, a deep sub drop under it and a scatter of debris a moment later; one across the street is the same, duller; one far off is only a low thump and a rumble a beat behind it, the way a distant blast really arrives. A tripwire mine snaps its wire and clicks just before it goes, so you can tell a wire going off from a grenade even across the map. The moment everything else dips under a blast stays as it was. Sound only: nothing in the raid changes.
now: Blasts now crack and thump close by and rumble far off, and a tripwire mine snaps its wire before it goes.
